To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

DF thresholding, the simplest method with a low cost in computation, can be reliably used to reduce the vocabulary in text categorization, instead of more expensive measures such as IG and CHI, that IG and CHI are highly correlated with DF and that term strength TS is a useful measure for vocabulary reduction.

(1) DF thresholding can be used instead of IG and CHI thresholding in text categorization; (2) IG and CHI are more e cient than TS and DF; (3) IG and CHi are highly correlated, and (4) MI is not competitive.
